name: Shop: Magic Items
description: A magic shop — enchanted wares, potions, and curiosities, not mundane goods. Tagged alongside Shop (not instead of it) to narrow what kind of point of sale this is.

mechanics.text: This shop's own Assets should mostly be magic-item-kind Wonders — the GM's own stock, priced and quantified like any other Shop's. Rarity-derived pricing (item-pricing.js) is a particularly good fit here.
